name: Sky-River Storm Drake
senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 14

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The storm drake makes two Talons attacks.

Actions.name: Talons
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.

Actions.name: Thunder Wall (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 42 (12d6) Thunder damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Traits.name: Storm-Hover
Traits.text: While it flies, the storm drake can hover, and winds buffet any creature that would strike at it in passing, so Opportunity Attacks against it are made with Disadvantage.

Traits.expressedQuote: winds buffet any creature that would strike at it in passing

lore: Hatched in the turbulent upper reaches of a sky-river canyon, this young storm drake claims its territory by bottling the canyon's thunder into a rolling wall of sound, and it desires nothing more than a lair safe from older, larger drakes.
